sentences.text: 4. This Court has heard learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers.
Following aspects are considered:-
[1] The fact of the applicant having been released in the substantive offence.

[2] While it is submitted that the applicant did not remain present before the learned Trial Court, on any occasion, this Court has also considered the fact that the present applicant has been arrested upon the warrant being issued on 15.12.2025 and he is in custody since that date.

[3] This Court has also considered the fact that the present applicant is the father of the main accused and whereas, the role attributed to the present applicant is only with regard to abetment of the offence.
[4] This Court has also considered the fact that the present applicant is an agriculture labourer normally residing in Madhya NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/4064/2026 ORDER DATED: 24/03/2026 undefined Pradesh.
[5] Considering such a situation, this Court is inclined to release of the present applicant, albeit subject to appropriate conditions.
5. In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the First Information Report, without discussing the evidence in detail,
prima facie
, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
6. Hence, the present application is allowed.
